Sheldon F.  Washn Jany 27th 1864 
Pagan Jany twenty seventh Nancy For 
Audit Bakers relay have left here

Jany 28. 1864.
Smith St Louis Mo. 
Pagan Jany twenty Eighth for Bangor
period Vernon Sedgwick suppers that two
Readings of Ewells Corps have left
for Queenly or Long - street one 
on the 20th & one on
the twenty fifth period Antwerp Anderson
suppers from Lexington of an expected
raid by Morgan through Stone or
Sounding gap into Ky applause Martha
